1.21.1.3.2.0.121012: Requires MMDLib 2.0.3. Every machine is now an MMDLib XML machine definition; existing worlds load unchanged. Machines use MMDLib's standard machine screen, with interactive tank gauges (pour or fill buckets on them), a pause button, and the side-configuration and redstone drawers. The steam crusher and steam furnace now run MMDLib machine recipes, which JEI shows: the crusher takes every crushing recipe as before (125 ticks, 18,750 mB of steam per item). The furnace runs on steam alone: no fuel slot or warm-up, three independent lanes that each smelt at the recipe's own cooking time, 2000 mB of steam per 200 ticks. Coal left in an old furnace's fuel slot is kept and comes out in the recovery capsule when the furnace is broken; work in progress in a crusher or furnace restarts after updating. Pack makers can override the generated recipes with recipe JSON. Broken machines now keep their fluids in a recovery capsule instead of losing them. Machines' blast resistance matches their hardness (3.5, down from 6).
1.21.1.3.1.0.121012: Requires MMDLib 2.0.2 and Power Advantage 3.2. Machines now build on MMDLib's shared machine base for saving, syncing and dropping contents; existing worlds load unchanged. Every machine now has MMDLib's side-configuration drawer: choose per face which slots, tanks and energy pipes and hoppers may use, and install Power Advantage's fluid intake and output pumps. Defaults match the old behavior. The steam drill mines at Steam Advantage 2's pace again (12 ticks per point of block hardness, adjustable with drillTicksPerHardness in the common config). It now returns blocks' normal drops instead of running them through crusher recipes, so stone types (including Mineralogy rocks) are no longer turned into gravel. Steam-Powered Still screen fits small windows again, and the update checker points at the correct repository.
1.21.1.3.0.3.121012: Restore villager offers, machine-specific comparator signals, drill crushing and rotating drill bits, connected drill-bit cleanup, gradual end-of-line retraction, and musket repair, tooltips, ammunition compatibility, block interactions, particles and camera kick.
1.21.1.3.0.2.121012: Steam drill: visible drill pipe, diamond-pickaxe mining speeds, 128-block range to reach modern bedrock, no longer retracts or flickers when short on steam, and no longer stalls with a full inventory.
